title: A Level 21 Blacksmith Just Became The First Player With Two Jobs . . . (Episode 4)
caption:
In Overgeared episode 4, Grid faces Euphemina in a three-hour dagger forging match. Then a rigged arrest throws him in a dungeon with one hour to save a stranger. Follow for episode 5!

#overgeared #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Would you have teamed up with Rabbit after everything he did to Grid? Why?

segments.say: A level twenty-one blacksmith just killed a knight way above his level. Now he has a second *job*.
To see how it got here, go back to the arena, where Grid faces Euphemina in a dagger *match*.
Whoever forges the best dagger in three hours *wins*.
Grid says he is Pogma's successor, and he refuses to *lose*.
Euphemina calls him a noob and tries to read his skills, but nothing shows *up*.
She has copied skills from smiths far above him, so she asks the host to bring Khan on stage as Grid's partner. Now it is two on *one*.
Grid can't see her real plan. She wants to copy Khan's master smith *skill*.
Clever, but totally unfair.
Then she grabs a giant hammer, and her iron begins to *glow*.
Grid forges beside Khan, and the old man says he is proud to work next to his *student*.
Then Grid pulls out his trick, a Minotaur horn that cost him ten *gold*.
But Euphemina finishes first, and her dagger glows like a *star*.
It is an epic dagger with crazy stats, and the host calls the match *over*.
The boss of the Merrow Company grins in his seat. He thinks he has already *won*.
Khan only smiles. He says the girl is no match for his *student*.
Then Grid's legendary smith skill kicks in, and his blade starts to *shine*.

segments.text: Crowd's gonna go nuts when I whip this out.

segments.say: But before anyone can see it, armed guards storm the *arena*.
They claim Hu-Roy confessed, and that Grid and Khan are *traitors*.
Rabbit planned this from the start. He never trusted them to *deliver*.
Then he tells Khan to hand over his *forge*.
Grid screams that this is a joke, but the guards drag him to *jail*.
The boss played dirty from the start.
Alone in the dark, his quest changes. Apostle of Justice, S-rank.
He has seven hours to break Hu-Roy out, or he loses two *levels*.
Back in the arena, Rabbit studies Grid's dagger and admits nothing on the continent can match its *craftsmanship*.
But the boss snaps that the crowd saw Euphemina win, so the dagger gets *hidden*.
She takes her reward, and she knows she only won because Grid got *arrested*.
Then Rabbit pulls her aside with a small *proposal*.
Meanwhile Khan gathers the villagers. They grab weapons to break Grid out of the *dungeon*.
But the Earl's guards arrive first, arrest the whole village, and the boss promises to take good care of Khan's *forge*.
Hu-Roy waits alone in the dark with six hours *left*.
At Morpheus, the execs are panicking. If a player dies in there, the game looks too *dangerous*.
Their numbers say Grid's odds are less than one *percent*.
But one exec reminds them Grid has beaten the odds before. They bet the last hour on *him*.

segments.text: If you exist, I'm gonna punch you over and over again!

segments.say: Then a girl in a cat hood appears at the bars. It is Euphemina, and she is his only *hope*.
She will free him if he forges her an orb. Grid agrees, and she cuts the *ropes*.
She makes him stop calling her fetus, then admits she is a Duplicator, an epic *class*.
Then guards close in, and Grid grabs his dagger to *fight*.
In the middle of the fight, he unlocks a new *skill*.
Euphemina will not work for free, until Grid begs, and then she wipes out half the *guards*.
She holds back, because a stronger skill could bring the whole dungeon *down*.
Grid leaves her to fight and runs to find Hu-Roy. Five minutes *left*.
Then a knight blocks the hall. Sir Leo, hero of Winston, and he is far above Grid's *level*.
That is not a fair fight.
Grid does not run. His blacksmith's wrath kicks in, and he glows *blue*.
Leo lifts his flaming sword and swears not even ashes will *remain*.
Grid dives in with his tiny dagger and cuts the knight *down*.
He jumps from level twenty-one to level forty-five in a *second*.
Then he finds Hu-Roy collapsed in a corner, looking like a terminally ill *raisin*.
Quest clear. Grid is the first player in Satisfye history with a second *job*.
Hu-Roy swears to repay him for the rest of his *life*.
At Morpheus, the execs let out a breath. Those two actually *did* it.
But the dungeon is still full of guards, and they have to *escape*.
Euphemina strolls in, and Grid asks what took her so *long*.
Hu-Roy tells them to run. He will stall the guards with his new *skill*.
His blue spirit sweeps through the hall and drops the guards one by *one*.
Outside, a full army waits, and the boss sits behind it, sure he has *won*.
Euphemina steps up. They are in the open now, so she finally cuts *loose*.
Her Demon King Tailfire wipes out the entire army with one *hit*.
Then Rabbit steps forward and says he is reporting his own boss to the *authorities*.
The boss asks how he dares. Rabbit shrugs. He is a merchant, and he follows the *profit*.
Euphemina tells Grid why she saved him. A little rabbit *asked* her to.
Rabbit then offers him a place in his new company and promises to make him *rich*.

segments.text: Oh, say that again, but slower.

segments.say: Euphemina reminds him he still owes her an orb. Grid promises, and shakes Rabbit's *hand*.
At Morpheus, the execs block Hu-Roy's login so he can rest, then admit Grid just made *history*.
Back home, Takumi slurps noodles while the news breaks that a player has two *jobs*.
Back in the village, Grid learns Rabbit got ten years in prison. So much for the new *company*.
Then Khan says the Earl is sending his own daughter to run the village, and Grid's life is about to get *worse*. Follow for episode 5!
